subject: Wellocity onboarding: S2CS transfer, owners, and initial risk log
participants_external: samir@wellocity.com (Samir Patel, VP Product, Wellocity Health)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@wellocity.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro + next steps for Wellocity onboarding (S2CS transfer)

Samir — great to have the agreement over the line. Quick note to connect you to Neha (CS lead) for the handoff. Below is the short transfer summary and ask list so we can hit the 90-day activation target.

Key context:
- Product: Redwood Hosted + Dedicated burst for staff assist workflows
- Committed capacity: 4 reserved GPUs (q3 ramp) + hosted API for dev/testing
- Critical SLO: 75 ms median token latency for staff assist path
- Key contacts: Samir (VP Product), Wellocity onboarding lead (onboarding@wellocity.com)

Asks for CS kickoff (before handoff completes):
1) Procurement has SOW signed and returned to RDW — (cc'd contracts). Confirm DocuSign receipt.
2) Provide sample workload: anonymized 48-hr request logs (small subset) for perf profile.
3) Confirm internal approvers for security questionnaire (SOC2 evidence request).

Neha / Marissa / Vivek — please see suggested owner split below and advise if any red flags. I can join the kickoff call if helpful.

Suggested ownership (proposed):
- Neha: overall onboarding & customer success owner (post-signing contact)
- Marissa: implementation lead — playbook, runbook, acceptance criteria
- Vivek: ops & infra contact — staging capacity, network/VPC planning for Dedicated

Attachments: Wellocity_SOW_v1.pdf (executed), rdw-implementation-checklist.xlsx (starter checklist)

Thanks — leaving it with you Neha.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0124

From: Samir Patel <samir@wellocity.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: contracts@wellocity.com, onboarding@wellocity.com
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps for Wellocity onboarding (S2CS transfer)

Thanks Aditya — excited to get started. A couple quick items from our side: 

1) DocuSign: SOW signed by our CFO and uploaded; contracts@ should have the countersigned copy.
2) Workload sample: we'll extract a 48-hr anonymized subset and share via secure transfer by Friday 2/12.
3) Security: our security owner (Claire Wu) will be the contact for SOC2 evidence; CC'd onboarding for introductions.

We'd like to schedule the kickoff for next week (2/16 or 2/17). Target agenda: introductions, runbook walkthrough, data ingress plan, acceptance criteria review.

One risk to flag: our internal network team requires a static egress IP list for the Dedicated staging environment — we likely need to finalize NAT/PEP settings early.

Happy to jump on a call Thurs if helpful.

—Samir
Samir Patel
VP Product, Wellocity Health
samir@wellocity.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@wellocity.com>, onboarding@wellocity.com, contracts@wellocity.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 08:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps for Wellocity onboarding (S2CS transfer)

Thanks Aditya / Samir — looping in planned owners and the initial onboarding plan. I've created a short risk log below and assigned owners for first-touch items. Please treat this as the working agenda for kickoff.

Kickoff proposed: Tue 2/16 @ 10:00 PT (30–45m) — will send calendar invite when Samir confirms.

Owner assignments & first tasks: 
- Neha Kapoor (CS lead) — overall project owner, acceptance criteria sign-off, weekly status updates. Deliverable: 30/60/90-day rollout milestones doc. Due: 2/19.
- Marissa Cole (Implementation) — build runbook, mapping to acceptance criteria, coordinate validation tests. Deliverable: draft runbook + test matrix. Due: 2/23.
- Vivek Kulkarni (Ops) — provide staging IP ranges, expected latency profile, pre-prod capacity plan for Dedicated. Deliverable: staging network spec + capacity template. Due: 2/18.
- Aditya Rao (Sales) — procurement liaison, billing/contract questions, and field escalation.

Initial risk log (quick):
1) Network egress constraint (Wellocity asks for static IP list) — Owner: Vivek — Mitigation: propose static NAT EIP pool or bring-your-own-proxy; ETA: 2/18.
2) Data sample delivery delayed — Owner: Marissa — Mitigation: provide synthetic sample template if customer can't extract logs; ETA: 2/12.
3) SOC2 evidence turnaround time — Owner: Neha — Mitigation: request Claire Wu's contact and pre-assemble common artifacts; ETA: 2/19.

Attachments: I've attached the signed SOW and our starter checklist for the kickoff. Please review before the call and add any items to the shared kickoff doc (link below).

Related links: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-wellocity-kickoff (editable kickoff notes)

Marissa / Vivek — flag anything I'm missing or adjust dates if needed. Samir — does 2/16 10:00 PT work for your team?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0188

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@wellocity.com>, onboarding@wellocity.com
Date: Thu, 11 Feb 2027 14:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps for Wellocity onboarding (S2CS transfer)

Thanks — quick operational notes:

1) Static IPs: we can allocate a /28 NAT pool for Wellocity's Dedicated staging and provide the list by 2/18. If they'd prefer an allowlist for hosted endpoints instead, we can provide that earlier (2/12).
2) Latency profiling: to get the 75ms median we should get a representative 48-hr workload. If Wellocity can't supply, we'll use the synthetic template Marissa mentioned.
3) Pre-prod capacity: attaching a short capacity template with expected throughput t-shirt sizes (light/med/heavy). I'll drop the staging network spec into the shared kickoff doc by COB tomorrow.

Attachment: rdw-implementation-checklist.xlsx (updated with capacity template)

I'll follow up with a calendar invite once Samir confirms the time.

—Vivek
